item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 27/Dec/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting the coast of Guangdong will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. The weather will be persistently fine and dry over the region. It will still be cool in the morning and daytime temperatures will rise slightly. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas. A band of clouds will cover southern China midweek next week. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week. The weather will become cool again over the region.
